title: Yellow
goal: Learn the words first, notice irregular past verbs and would, and think about what the narrator does for love.
goal_it: Impara prima le parole, nota i verbi irregolari al passato e would, e pensa a cosa fa il narratore per amore.

steps.title: About the song
en: Title: Yellow. Artist: Coldplay, a British band formed in London. The song comes from their first album, Parachutes (2000). It is a simple, warm love song.
Search for the title and the artist in your own music app. Listen three times this week, each time with a different job:
Listening 1: catch the words from the next screen. Listening 2: notice the grammar points. Listening 3: think about what the person in the song does for the one he loves.
it: Titolo: Yellow. Artista: Coldplay, gruppo britannico nato a Londra. La canzone viene dal loro primo album, Parachutes (2000). È una canzone d'amore semplice e calda.
Cerca titolo e artista nella tua app di musica. Ascoltala tre volte questa settimana, ogni volta con un compito diverso:
Ascolto 1: individua le parole della prossima schermata. Ascolto 2: nota i punti di grammatica. Ascolto 3: pensa a cosa fa la persona nella canzone per chi ama.

steps.title: Words you will hear
en: These words are in the song or very close to its world. Learn them first, then try to catch them while you listen.
it: Queste parole sono nella canzone o molto vicine al suo mondo. Imparale prima, poi prova a riconoscerle mentre ascolti.

head: English
Italiano
Example
rows: The sun shines on the sea.
He broke a bone in his arm.
The cat jumped onto the table.
She drew a line on the map.
He wrote a song for his wife.

steps.q: What is the past simple of 'swim'?
steps.q_it: Qual è il past simple di 'swim'?
steps.why: Swim is irregular: swim, swam, swum.
steps.why_it: Swim è irregolare: swim, swam, swum.

steps.q: She ___ (write) a letter to her friend yesterday.
steps.q_it: Ieri ha scritto una lettera alla sua amica.

steps.q: He ___ (draw) a line on the map.
steps.q_it: Ha tracciato una linea sulla mappa.

steps.title: Three grammar points to watch for
steps.title_it: Tre punti di grammatica da tenere d'occhio
en: 1. Irregular past simple verbs. The song tells small stories in the past. Listen for verbs like come, write, take, swim, draw: came, wrote, took, swam, drew.
2. Would for something you are ready to do: I would do anything for you. In the short form: I'd. It shows willingness or devotion.
3. The imperative. The song starts with a command, a short instruction with no subject: Look at that! Listen to this!
During listening 2, try to notice where the singer uses each one.
it: 1. Verbi irregolari al past simple. La canzone racconta piccole storie al passato. Ascolta verbi come come, write, take, swim, draw: came, wrote, took, swam, drew.
2. Would per qualcosa che sei pronto a fare: I would do anything for you. Forma breve: I'd. Mostra disponibilità o dedizione.
3. L'imperativo. La canzone inizia con un comando, un'istruzione breve senza soggetto: Look at that! Listen to this!
Durante l'ascolto 2, prova a notare dove chi canta usa ciascuno.

examples.en: I came home late and wrote a message.
examples.it: Sono tornato tardi a casa e ho scritto un messaggio.

examples.en: I'd do anything for my best friend.
examples.it: Farei qualsiasi cosa per la mia migliore amica.

steps.q: 'I'd do anything for you.' What does 'I'd' mean here?
steps.q_it: 'I'd do anything for you.' Cosa significa 'I'd' qui?
steps.why: Before a base verb, 'd = would: I would do.
steps.why_it: Prima di un verbo base, 'd = would: I would do.

steps.q: I ___ do anything for my family. (farei)
steps.q_it: Farei qualsiasi cosa per la mia famiglia.
steps.why: Would shows what you are ready to do.
steps.why_it: Would mostra cosa sei pronto a fare.

answers: He swam across the river for her
steps.why: Subject + past simple + place + for + person.
steps.why_it: Soggetto + past simple + luogo + for + persona.

steps.title: Now listen (listening 1 and 2)
en: Open your music app and listen once. Try to catch at least four words from the table. Then listen again and notice the grammar points.
Come back when you finish and answer the questions about meaning.
it: Apri la tua app di musica e ascolta una volta. Prova a riconoscere almeno quattro parole della tabella. Poi riascolta e nota i punti di grammatica.
Torna qui quando hai finito e rispondi alle domande sul significato.

steps.q: Which of these things does the narrator say he did for the person?
steps.q_it: Quale di queste cose dice di aver fatto il narratore per la persona?
steps.why: Swimming across and drawing a line are two of the things he mentions.
steps.why_it: Attraversare a nuoto e tracciare una linea sono due delle cose che cita.

steps.q: What do these actions have in common?
steps.q_it: Cosa hanno in comune queste azioni?
options: They show effort and sacrifice for love
steps.why: Each action is a way of saying: I would go far for you.
steps.why_it: Ogni azione è un modo per dire: andrei lontano per te.

steps.q: The word 'yellow' comes back many times. Which reading is best?
steps.q_it: La parola 'yellow' ritorna molte volte. Quale lettura è la migliore?
options: It is the name of a town
It is a personal symbol of how special the person is
It is the colour of a car
steps.why: The colour works like a private word for something bright and precious.
steps.why_it: Il colore funziona come una parola privata per qualcosa di luminoso e prezioso.

steps.q: The song also talks about skin and bones turning into something beautiful. What does this suggest?
steps.q_it: La canzone parla anche di pelle e ossa che diventano qualcosa di bello. Cosa suggerisce?
options: He wants to change the person
He is talking about a doctor
He sees beauty even in the ordinary, human side of the person
steps.why: Skin and bones = the ordinary body. Love makes it beautiful to him.
steps.why_it: Pelle e ossa = il corpo comune. L'amore lo rende bello ai suoi occhi.

steps.q: Which sentence is the best summary of the narrator's feelings?
steps.q_it: Quale frase riassume meglio i sentimenti del narratore?
options: Simple, strong devotion: he gives a lot and says it plainly
He is bored and wants to leave
He is angry and wants revenge
steps.why: The words are simple, the feeling is big.
steps.why_it: Le parole sono semplici, il sentimento è grande.

steps.q: Last summer I ___ (swim) across a small lake.
steps.q_it: L'estate scorsa ho attraversato a nuoto un piccolo lago.

steps.why: Imperative: base verb with no subject.

steps.title: Your task this week
en: Listening 3: listen again and think about what the narrator does for the person he loves.

In your notes write four sentences in your own words: (1) One thing you would do for someone you love (use would). (2) One small story from last week with two irregular past verbs. (3) What yellow means to you, or what colour you would choose and why. (4) One command you would give to a friend.
Do not copy the words of the song.
it: Ascolto 3: riascolta e pensa a cosa fa il narratore per la persona che ama.

Nelle note scrivi quattro frasi con parole tue: (1) Una cosa che faresti per una persona che ami (usa would). (2) Una piccola storia della settimana scorsa con due verbi irregolari al passato. (3) Cosa significa il giallo per te, o quale colore sceglieresti e perché. (4) Un comando che daresti a un amico.
Non copiare le parole della canzone.

cards.ex: The sun shines on the sea.
He broke a bone in his arm.
She drew a line on the map.
He wrote a song for his wife.
I'd do anything for my friend.
